items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Sonny Criss, I recorded with him.

ctx.x: Sonny Criss, I recorded with him. He committed suicide. The funny thing about him was, you know what, he wouldn’t make two takes. He made one take of everything and refused to make any other takes. The album that I did with him I had to finish that album by myself, I had to finish with some tracks and repeal stuff, I’ve never even heard the album. That’s the one I’d like to hear, with Sonny Criss. Write that down, if you ever run into that man, let me know. You know, Sonny Criss, he wouldn’t make two takes.
